title: Merge the EUR branch through its conflict

ticket.subject: Please merge feature/eur-reporting into main
body: Priya's `feature/eur-reporting` switches the reports to EUR and is approved. Meanwhile main moved on: the
pipeline now runs in Paris time. Git will stop on a conflict in `config/settings.yml`.
- Merge `feature/eur-reporting` into `main` **with a merge commit** (we keep the feature's history visible:
- resolve the conflict keeping both changes: Paris time from main, EUR from the feature. Nothing else in the
file changes, and no conflict marker is left behind;
- delete the branch once it is merged;
- finish on main with a clean tree.

acceptance.text: main has a merge commit that brings in the feature's commit.

includes_subjects: fix: run the pipeline in Paris time

acceptance.text: config/settings.yml on main keeps Paris time and EUR, with no conflict marker; the feature's code is in.
You are on main, nothing in progress, the tree is clean.

hints: `git log --oneline --graph --all` shows both branches and where they split. `git merge --no-ff feature/eur-reporting` from main always makes a merge commit.
On a conflict, `git status` lists the files to fix. Edit `config/settings.yml`: keep the lines you want and remove the `<<<<<<<`, `=======` and `>>>>>>>` markers.
Then `git add config/settings.yml` and `git commit` (Git has prepared the merge message). `git merge --abort` starts the merge over if you are lost.
`git branch -d feature/eur-reporting` deletes a branch that is merged (`-d` refuses otherwise, which is a useful safety).
